places.name: Stellenbosch Wine Route
places.ai_summary: A scenic route featuring some of South Africa's finest vineyards, offering wine tastings, cellar tours, and picturesque landscapes.
places.place_tip: Book a guided tour to visit multiple vineyards in one day.

places.name: Franschhoek Village & Tram Tour
places.ai_summary: A charming village known for its French heritage, gourmet dining, and the iconic wine tram that takes visitors through the vineyards.
places.place_tip: Reserve your tram tickets in advance to secure your spot.

places.name: Paarl Rock Nature Reserve
places.ai_summary: A natural reserve featuring the iconic Paarl Rock, hiking trails, and breathtaking views of the surrounding winelands.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the hike to the top.

places.name: Spier Wine Estate
places.ai_summary: A historic wine estate offering a variety of wines, gourmet food, and activities like cheetah encounters and boat trips.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the wine and chocolate pairing experience.

places.name: Boschendal Estate
places.ai_summary: A beautiful estate known for its wines, farm-to-table dining, and outdoor activities like hiking and mountain biking.
places.place_tip: Explore the extensive gardens and consider a picnic.

places.name: Delaire Graff Estate
places.ai_summary: An exclusive estate offering luxury wines, fine dining, and a spa, set against the stunning backdrop of the Helshoogte Pass.
places.place_tip: Indulge in the spa treatments for a complete experience.

places.name: Franschhoek Motor Museum
places.ai_summary: A must-visit for car enthusiasts, this museum showcases a vast collection of classic cars, motorcycles, and automotive memorabilia.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a wine tour in Franschhoek.

places.name: Huguenot Monument
places.ai_summary: A historical monument commemorating the French Huguenots who settled in the area, featuring a museum and beautiful gardens.
places.place_tip: Explore the nearby village for a complete experience.

places.name: Babylonstoren Farm & Gardens
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved historic farm with beautiful gardens, a winery, and a farm shop offering fresh produce and local products.
places.place_tip: Try the farm-to-table restaurant for a unique dining experience.

places.name: Stellenbosch Village Museum
places.ai_summary: A collection of historical buildings and museums showcasing the rich history and cultural heritage of Stellenbosch.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for in-depth knowledge of the exhibits.

places.name: Rupert Museum
places.ai_summary: An art museum featuring a collection of South African and international art, including works by Pieter Hugo and Irma Stern.
places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions for unique art experiences.

places.name: Eagle Encounters Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: A wildlife rehabilitation center and sanctuary where visitors can learn about and interact with birds of prey.

opening_hours.notes: Feeding times are the best for interaction.

places.place_tip: Participate in the owl encounter for a unique experience.

places.name: Vrede en Lust Estate
places.ai_summary: A picturesque wine estate known for its elegant wines, beautiful gardens, and stunning views of the Simonsberg Mountain.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic in the gardens with a bottle of their wine.

places.name: Jonkershoek Nature Reserve
places.ai_summary: A stunning nature reserve offering hiking trails, mountain biking routes, and breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and valleys.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 7 PM, no late entries allowed.

places.place_tip: Bring enough water and snacks for your hike.

attribution.title: 108 Dorp Street, Stellenbosch
attribution.author: Ossewa
attribution.description: The original part of this historic house dates from the beginning of the nineteenth century and was later adapted to the Georgian style. It forms an integral part of the architecturally and historically important street scene of Dorp Street.

places.name: Muratie Wine Estate
places.ai_summary: A family-owned wine estate with a rich history, offering a range of wines and a unique tasting experience in a beautiful setting.
places.place_tip: Try their famous port-style wine.

places.name: Simonsig Wine Cellar
places.ai_summary: A renowned wine cellar known for its innovative wines and beautiful estate, offering tastings and cellar tours.
places.place_tip: Don't miss their signature wine, the Simonsig Kaapse Vonkel.

places.name: Waterford Estate
places.ai_summary: A beautiful estate known for its Bordeaux-style wines, offering tastings, vineyard tours, and a unique wine and chocolate pairing experience.
places.place_tip: Pair your wine tasting with their artisanal chocolates.

places.name: Neethlingshof Estate
places.ai_summary: A historic wine estate with a variety of wines, beautiful gardens, and a restaurant offering stunning views of the vineyards.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at the restaurant for a complete experience.

places.ai_summary: A flexible and scenic way to explore the Franschhoek wine region, allowing visitors to hop on and off at various wineries.
places.place_tip: Start early to visit multiple wineries in one day.

places.name: Gourmet Dining Experience
places.ai_summary: Indulge in a culinary journey at one of the many gourmet restaurants in the region, offering exquisite cuisine and fine wines.
places.place_tip: Pair your meal with local wines for a complete experience.
